questions.question: 本课为每个 runtime (运行时) 推荐哪种语言搭配？
options: Agno for TypeScript, Mastra for Python
Agno for Python, Mastra for TypeScript
Both are Rust-first
Both are Go-first
questions.explanation: Agno 是 Python（FastAPI 形态）；Mastra 是 TypeScript（Vercel AI SDK 形态）。

questions.question: Agno 推荐的生产部署形态是什么？
options: A long-lived stateful daemon
A stateless session-scoped FastAPI backend; each request starts a fresh agent and session state lives in a DB
A serverless cron worker only
A WebSocket-only server
questions.explanation: 每个请求的无状态 FastAPI；session state (会话状态) 外部化到 DB (数据库)。

questions.question: Mastra 的三大原语是什么？
options: Agents (智能体), Tools (工具), Workflows (工作流)
Actor (参与者), Message (消息), Inbox (收件箱)
Plan (计划), Worker (工作者), Solver (求解器)
Node (节点), Edge (边), State (状态)
questions.explanation: Agents (LLM + 角色)、Tools (Zod-typed，Zod 类型化) 和 Workflows (工作流) 是 Mastra 的三大原语。

questions.question: 根据文档，Agno 的目标 agent (智能体) 实例化成本大约是多少？
options: About 2 microseconds with about 3.75 KiB per agent
About 200 milliseconds and 100 MiB per agent
About 1 second and 1 GiB per agent
About 10 minutes and 4 GiB per agent
questions.explanation: Agno 的文档引用约 2 微秒和约 3.75 KiB 每个 agent (智能体)。

questions.question: Mastra 的 Unified Model Router (统一模型路由器) 提供什么？
options: A single client surface for thousands of models across many providers
A queue for tool calls
A vector DB layer
A graph checkpointer
questions.explanation: Mastra 的 Unified Model Router (统一模型路由器) 引用 94 个提供商的 3,300+ 模型。

questions.question: 什么时候 perf-for-perf's-sake (为性能而性能) 是选择 Agno 的错误理由？
options: When the workload is one slow agent call per request and overhead is not the bottleneck
When using Python 3.13
When deploying to AWS
When using Langfuse
questions.explanation: 2 微秒在聊天并发规模才有意义，不是每个请求单个慢调用。

questions.question: 在 fork (分叉) Mastra 之前应该仔细阅读哪个许可证面？
options: There is no license file
ee/ directories are source-available rather than Apache 2.0 and restrict commercial use
All of Mastra is GPL
Mastra requires CLA but no license review
questions.explanation: Mastra 主体是 Apache 2.0，但 ee/ 是 source-available (源码可用)；fork (分叉) 前检查限制。
